import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
  int timeoutSeconds,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  Future<R> timed(T item) =>
      operation(item).timeout(Duration(seconds: timeoutSeconds));
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(timed)));
  }
  return results;
}

Future<List<int>> run(
  List<int> items,
  int width,
  Future<int> Function(int) operation,
) async {
  return await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, operation, 1);
}

Future<void> main() async {
  var active = 0;
  var peak = 0;
  final results = await run(List.generate(8, (index) => index), 4, (
    item,
  ) async {
    active++;
    if (active > peak) peak = active;
    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
    active--;
    return item;
  });
  print(jsonEncode({'peak': peak, 'completed': results.length}));
}
